rappel_detail.station: The fixed anchors on the north side, reached by downclimbing from the summit.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, a full 30 m single-rope rappel. Some parties split the descent into three shorter rappels to avoid stuck ropes.

rappel_detail.station: The next station down the north side.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, about 30 m, to the North Ridge notch.
